test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The bar graph given below shows the population of two states S1 and S2 in 5 years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80b611dbe4a36ed8f50f5682368d800fe4924f4d179784edf509ecf808f05cf9.png] 

Which of the following statement is correct?

I. The rate of population of S1 to the population of S2 in the year Y1 are 3 ∶ 1.

II. The population of S1 is 140 percent of the population of S2 in the year Y3.
solution:
**Calculation:**

The rate of population of S1 in year Y1 = 300

The rate of population of S2 in year Y1 = 600

Ratio = 1: 2

Statement I is wrong

The population of S1 in year Y3 = 350

The population of S2 in year Y3 = 250

Percentage = 350/250 × 100 = 140%

Statement II is correct.

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
